question: Which of the following Rajiv Gandhi National Sadbhavana Awards was conferred on Ustad Amjad Ali Khan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**21st**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• The Rajiv Gandhi National Sadbhavana Award is given annually by the Indian National Congress party.

• The award aims to recognize outstanding contributions towards promoting peace, harmony, and national integration in India.

• Ustad Amjad Ali Khan, a renowned sarod maestro, was honored with the 21st Rajiv Gandhi National Sadbhavana Award.

• The award was conferred on him in recognition of his efforts to promote communal harmony and peace through music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Rajiv Gandhi National Sadbhavana Award**

• The award was instituted in 1992, in memory of Rajiv Gandhi, the former Prime Minister of India.

• It is awarded annually on his birth anniversary, 20th August.

• Recipients of the award are given a citation and a cash prize.

• The award celebrates individuals and organizations who have made significant contributions towards promoting values of harmony and peace.

• **Ustad Amjad Ali Khan**

• He is an Indian classical musician who plays the sarod, a stringed instrument.

• He has been awarded several prestigious awards including the Padma Vibhushan, India's second-highest civilian honor.

• He comes from a long lineage of sarod players and has significantly contributed to the Indian classical music scene.

• His music is known for its spiritual depth and ability to transcend cultural barriers.
